We have a Monopoly situation. Player p1 (Alpha) has cash 290, position FREE_PARKING, not in jail. Holdings: owned properties: READING_RAILROAD (no houses), ORIENTAL_AVENUE (2 houses), VERMONT_AVENUE (2 houses), CONNECTICUT_AVENUE (2 houses), ELECTRIC_COMPANY. No mortgaged properties. Bank: houses remaining 18, hotels 12. Unowned spaces many.

Post-turn actions: can build houses/hotel on ORIENTAL, VERMONT, CONNECTICUT (the light blue set). They currently have 2 houses each. In Monopoly, you must build evenly across a color group. Light blue set: Oriental, Vermont, Connecticut. They have 2 houses each, so they can build a third house on each (must be even). They have cash 290. Cost of houses: Light blue houses cost $50 each (I recall). Actually in classic Monopoly, Light Blue houses cost $50. So building one house on each would cost $150 total (3 houses). They could also build a fourth house on each (another $150). They have $290, so they could afford 5 houses total? But must be even: can build up to 4 houses each (max 4). To go from 2 to 3 houses each: need 3 houses = $150. To go to 4 houses each: need another 3 houses = $150, total $300, which exceeds cash 290. So they can only build 3 houses (one on each) costing $150, leaving cash 140. Could also consider building a hotel? Need 4 houses each then hotel, not possible.

Mortgage options: ELECTRIC_COMPANY and READING_RAILROAD. Mortgage values: Electric Company mortgage value $75? Actually Electric Company mortgage is $75. Reading Railroad mortgage is $100. Mortgaging would give cash but lose rent. Might be useful to get cash for building houses? Already have enough cash for houses. Could also mortgage to have more cash for future purchases. But building houses increases rent significantly, especially with 3 houses on each light blue: rent $550? Actually Light Blue rent with 3 houses is $550? Wait typical: Light Blue rent: 0 houses $6, 1 house $30, 2 houses $90, 3 houses $270, 4 houses $400, hotel $550. So building 3 houses each yields rent $270 each. That's good.

Given cash 290, building 3 houses costs $150, leaving 140. Could also consider mortgaging a property to have more cash for later purchases (maybe to buy unowned property when landing). But we don't know upcoming turn. Probably best to build houses now to increase rent and deter opponents. Also could consider building houses on all three to keep even. So we should use build_houses_or_hotel action.

We need to provide build_plan: list of space_key, kind "HOUSE", count 1 for each? Actually we need to specify count per space. Build 1 house on each of the three. So build_plan = [{space_key:"ORIENTAL_AVENUE", kind:"HOUSE", count:1}, {space_key:"VERMONT_AVENUE", kind:"HOUSE", count:1}, {space_key:"CONNECTICUT_AVENUE", kind:"HOUSE", count:1}].

Public message: maybe something like "Building houses on my Light Blue set." Could be friendly or deceptive. Private thought: reasoning.

Thus we call build_houses_or_hotel.
